basic_details.post_name: Consultant - Certification Unit (Quality and Patient Safety Division)

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 45 years | Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

qualification.details: MBBS/ BDS/ BAMS/ BHMS/ B.Sc. Nursing/BSc. (Hons.) in Biotechnology/ Computer Sc./ IT/ Applied sciences with Two years full-time post-graduation diploma/ degree in Hospital Management/ Health Administration/ Public Health with specialization in Health Information Technology from a recognized institute. Two years post-qualification experience after PG. At least One year experience of NQAS implementation in public health facilities at district/State/National level.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 01-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NHSRC to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Consultant Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NHSRC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download NHSRC Consultant Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.text: A total of 1 vacancy is available - 1 for Consultant.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Consultant Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Two years post-qualification experience after PG. At least One year experience of NQAS implementation in public health facilities at district/State/National level.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Consultant Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 45 years Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHSRC Consultant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 01-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NHSRC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NHSRC Consultant post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Consultant - Certification Unit (Quality and Patient Safety Division) position at NHSRC is 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an MBBS/BDS/BAMS/BHMS/B.Sc. Nursing/BSc. (Hons.) in relevant fields, along with a post-graduation diploma/degree in Hospital Management/Health Administration/Public Health with a specialization in Health Information Technology.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for this position is 45 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Consultant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 60,000/- to Rs. 1,20,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Consultant - Certification Unit (Quality and Patient Safety Division).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview and potentially a Written Test, where candidates need to score a minimum of 70%.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity with the National Health Systems Resource Centre.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for this NHSRC recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for this recruitment is New Delhi, Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF and the online application link in the "Important Links" section of this article.
